# GYMEZY (https://gymezy.com)

> GYMEZY is a premier fitness tech platform and multi-gym network that connects fitness enthusiasts with verified local fitness centers, flexible pay-per-session passes, multi-gym memberships, and certified 1-on-1 personal trainers.

## Core Features & Offerings

- **Pay-Per-Session Daily Passes**: Users can book single-day gym passes across top verified gyms with instant 24-hour access and contactless OTP/QR entry.
- **Flexible Memberships**: 1, 3, 6, and 12-month memberships with multi-gym flexibility and zero lock-in contracts.
- **Certified Personal Coaches**: Direct booking for verified trainers specializing in strength training, weight loss, HIIT, bodybuilding, and customized workout/nutrition guidance.
- **Studio & Group Classes**: Real-time slot reservations for Yoga, Zumba Fitness, HIIT, CrossFit, and MMA boxing classes.
- **Gym Partner Portal**: Dedicated management software for fitness center owners to manage memberships, capture drop-in revenue, and verify entries via dynamic QR codes.
- **Trainer Ecosystem**: Platform for certified personal trainers to expand their client base, manage workout schedules, and receive instant payouts.

## Target Geography & Availability

- Primary Network: India (Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune) and expanding globally.
- Access: Mobile Web, iOS App, Android App.
